sources.store: run.db, opened read-only; every query filtered by run_id
sources.labels: anonymise.json — a run with no entry is excluded, never renamed
sources.budgetShaped: asked of the verbs, never computed here: tokens per checkpoint, blended $/M and the stage split come from `conductor money --run <id> --json`; floors, median closers, wrap-up and cap values come from `conductor budget`
